records.title: Boc the Seamster
records.description:
Boc the Seamster or Demi-Human Boc is an NPC in Elden Ring. He offers the player the ability to modify their garments, free of charge.
==Overview== 
Boc is a demi-human seamster from Limgrave. He was very close to his mother, a seamstress, until her passing. Inspired by her, Boc aspired to follow in her footsteps and inherited her sewing kit. He lived with a demi-human tribe in a Coastal Cave on the western coast of Limgrave, but at some point, he was cast out by his kin. Lost and isolated, Boc was transformed into a bush by a spell.
A Tarnished came across Boc and broke the spell, freeing him. Grateful, Boc offered to sneak back into the cave where he had been exiled to retrieve something precious with which to repay his champion. However, his former tribe discovered him and beat him mercilessly. When the champion found Boc again, he warned them not to enter the cave. Ignoring his warning, the champion avenged Boc and recovered his mother's cherished sewing needle. Moved by their kindness, Boc vowed to become a seamster like his mother.

records.title: Lanya
records.description:
Lanya is a character in Elden Ring. She is a servant of House Hoslow and childhood companion of Diallos Hoslow.
Described by Diallos as being "fickle as the wind," she has a habit of running off to unknown places, frequently requiring him to search for her whereabouts. 
She would eventually meet her fate in the middle of one of her disappearances, having been murdered by an unspecified Recusant of Volcano Manor, and her body was left in a pool of blood at the northern edge of Academy Gate Town. This act that would put Diallos on a path of revenge; however, true to his nature, he was unable to commit to the act in the end, instead joining the Recusants himself as a prospective champion. He would still feel pain and sadness over Lanya's death, calling it cruel and unfortunate, but believed they were both simply laid hard roads by fate.

records.title: Queen Marika the Eternal
records.description:
Queen Marika the Eternal is the central character in the world of Elden Ring. She is the divine ruler of the Lands Between and the current vessel of the Elden Ring, a god in truth. She grew the towering Erdtree, concealed the Realm of Shadow, and established the Golden Order. By the time of the game's events, she has long vanished from public view, though her influence persists through the Grace of Gold. Her Demigod offspring became shardbearers when they claimed Great Runes that dispersed when she shattered the Elden Ring. 
Information about Marika is primarily provided by Melina, Finger Reader Enia, and various item descriptions.

records.title: Rauh Goddess Statue
records.description:
Rauh Goddess Statues, also referred to as Rauh Queen Statues and other names in the community, are objects in Elden Ring. All information about the statues and the unseen character they depict is conjectural, based on visual details and contextual clues.
==Characteristics== 
thumb|Hornsent pray to the statue
Statues of a mysterious woman with a great octagonal crown are prominently featured throughout the Ancient Ruins of Rauh, a land blessed by the primordial Crucible of life. Both the hornsent and Kindred of Rot offer their prayers to this goddess-like figure. The Verdigris Discus can be found under one of these statues. The [[Antiquity Scholar's Cookbook 2|Antiquity Scholar's Cookbook [2] ]] and the Bondstone are located beneath another, held by the corpse of a hornsent. In addition, female figures with pointed headpieces and long side veils are represented in other artistic reliefs at the Rauh ruins.
